purpose: Reuse the same prospective 48-case public semantic-failure outputs across A12 recovery-family ablation and A9 acceptance-policy evaluation so the two research questions do not duplicate inference.

inference_plan.model: MinerU same-family recipe frozen before scoring

historical_demo_cost_basis.scope_warning: These are 18-page demo inference estimates, not invoices and not hard-case measurements. They exclude startup/orchestration/storage/transfer/evaluation/tax and may understate the prospective pilot.

planning_reserve.interpretation: A 3x reserve still fits the registered nominal USD 3 pilot cap on the historical per-page basis; actual provider/runtime preflight must replace this estimate before spend.

gpu_parallelism.rule: Shard independent cases only. Parallelism is for wall-clock compression and must not add extra arms/repeats or raise the registered total-work budget.

ground_truth_policy: No evaluator labels or ground truth mount on GPU workers. Only source inputs and frozen model/runtime instructions are sent; scoring is local after output hashes are frozen.
reuse_policy: If an exact output already exists under the same immutable action/model/source/settings identity, reuse it.
Paddle and DeepSeek outputs feed both A12 independent-family recovery analysis and A9 agreement/source-grounded acceptance analysis.
The original failed base prediction is reused from the frozen public failure pack and is not rerun merely to create an ablation.
Do not add a self-confidence arm unless the original model/runtime genuinely emits a frozen confidence feature.

requires_before_any_gpu: same-family ablation recipe frozen before outcome scoring

claim_boundary: Budget/reuse plan only. No model arm has been executed by this plan and no quality/cost-performance claim is authorized.
